plugins.name: project-audit
plugins.description: Use when a codebase needs a production-readiness audit, security review, feature-completeness check, client-friendly summary, or an hours estimate. Detects the stack (Stripe, Supabase, Convex, Firebase, Neon, MongoDB, Clerk, Expo, Capacitor, Twilio, AWS, and more), recommends the official plugin for each, runs parallel reviewer agents, and writes audit.md, audit-brief.md and estimate.md.
